title: failure modes
description: A project's failure modes: data/failure-modes/<failure_modes_id>.yaml (PLAN_0.8.0 D1). The ways an output can be wrong, named once, so tags on outputs are counted, not re-invented in each note (error analysis: open notes first, then a named taxonomy).

id.description: What a sheet's cell names, e.g. invented-fact.

description.description: When an output has it: what a tagger reads before tagging.
